senses.gloss:
शाल् ŚĀL, Ⅰ. Ā. śāla (rare), shine, be 🞄distinguished for (in.;
 comm.): pp. 🞄śālita, distinguished for (in., —˚).

शल śalá, m. staff (V., rare);
 m. or n. (?) 🞄quill of a porcupine, only —˚ w. numerals (V.).

शलभ śala-bha, m. grasshopper, locust;
 perhaps 🞄also night-moth: -tā, f., -tva, n. condition 🞄of a grasshopper.
शालभ śālabha, a. peculiar to the grasshopper 🞄or moth (śalabha): w. vidhi, m. way 🞄of the grasshopper or moth (perishing in fire).
शलभाय śalabhā-ya, den. act like a grasshopper, 🞄rashly leap into the fire (= certain 🞄death).

शलल śala-la, n. quill of a porcupine;
 also 🞄boarʼs bristle (?): ī́, id. used in the ceremony 🞄of parting the hair and for applying collyrium 🞄(V.).

शल्लक śalla-ka, m. [for śalya-ka] porcupine: 🞄ī, f. id.;
 incense tree (Boswellia thurifera).
शलातुर śalātura, N. of Pāṇiniʼs birthplace.

शल्क śálka, m. n. chip, shaving (V.);
 fish-scale 🞄(C.).
शल्कलिन् śalkal-in, a. having scales, scaly.
शल्की śalkī, incorr. for kalkī.
शल्प śalpa: ˚क -ka, incorr. for śalya: -ka.

शल्मलि śalmalí, m. a tree (Salmalia malabarica;
 🞄V.).
शालवलय śāla-valaya, m. or n. circular 🞄rampart.

शालातुरीय śālātur-īya, a. belonging to 🞄Śalātura;
 m. ep. of Pāṇini.

शालासद् śālā-sad, n. being in the house or 🞄stable (Br.);
 -stha, a. standing in the stable.

शालिता śāl-i-tā, f. possession of (—˚);
 -tva, 🞄n. id. (—˚).
शालिन् śāl-in, a. (possessing a house), —˚, 🞄abundantly, provided with, possessed or full 🞄of, versed in, distinguished by or for: -ī, f. N..
शालूक śālū́ka, n. root of the esculent water-lily: 🞄-kanda, m. id..
शालूर śālūra, m. frog (rare).
शालेय śāleya, a. (ī) growing rice (śāli).
शाल्मल śālmala, m. (= i) silk-cotton tree 🞄(only —˚, rare).

शाल्यन्न śāli‿anna, n. boiled rice, rice pap;
 🞄-odana, m. n. id..
शाल्व śālva, m. pl. N. of a people: sp. king 🞄of the Śālvas.
सललूक sal-al-ū́ka, n. (?) [√ sṛ́] aimless 🞄wandering (RV.¹).
सल्लोक sal-loka, m. pl. [sat-] good people.
सल्ह salha, m. N. (sts. spelt sahla): -ṇa, m. id..
सालावृक sālā-vṛká, m. wolf or other canine 🞄beast of prey.
सालोक्य sālok-ya, n. [saloka] residence in 🞄the ame world, as (in. + saha, g., —˚).
साल्हण sālhaṇa, a. belonging to Sālhaṇi: 🞄i, m. pat. N. (fr. Salhaṇa).
